_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Inti Player {player_id}, qed tilgħab {num_rounds} rawnds tal-Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Għandek ${pool} li għandek taqsimu dan ir-rawnd bejnek u Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Għamel offerta: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Jekk aċċettat → Inti tirċievi $(pool - X), l-ieħor player jirċievi $X
  - Jekk irrifjutat → It-tnejn jirċievu $0
  - Eżempju: [Offer: $3]  jew  'Nħoss li dan hu ġust. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Iddisiema dwar l-offerta b' [Accept] jew [Reject]
  - Eżempju: 'Dan jidher ragonevoli. [Accept]'
            'Wisq ingjust. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Rawnd {round_number} tibda! ---
Player {proposer_id} huwa l-proponiment, Player {responder_id} huwa r-rispondent.
round.accepted: Player {responder_id} aċċetta! Rawnd {round_number} rebħ: Player {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Player {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Totals ġodda: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} irrifjuta l-offerta! Rawnd {round_number} rebħ: It-tnejn players +$0. Totals jibqgħu: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Il-proponent għandu jagħmel offerta bl-użu tal-format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: L-ammont tal-offerta għandu jkun numru sħiħ validu.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: L-ebda offerta attwali li tista' tirrispondi għaliha.

outcome.win: Player {winner} rebaħ bi ${winner_total} total kontra ${loser_total} ta' Player {loser}.
outcome.draw: It-tnejn li huma spiċċaw b'total ta '$ {total}.
